windows.note: in-sample period of all earlier studies

execution.main: NEXT_CLOSE_PROXY: signal at D close, fill at next session close. SOXL open/high/low/close all set to the SOXL adjClose of that day (split+dividend adjusted, total return); no separate dividend booking to avoid double counting. Used for ALL 8 windows because SOXL opens exist only from 2024-10-01 in the fixed input.
execution.bridge: NEXT_OPEN (original rows + issuer dividend schedule) for W2024_CURRENT only, to measure the execution-proxy effect and to reproduce earlier stored results.

grid.rsi_rule: null => PROFIT_ONLY; otherwise OR (sell all when profit target OR SOXX RSI14>=threshold, with the unchanged 2% net-gain gate)
grid.run_count: 53 x 8 windows x 2 delays (close proxy) + 53 x 2 delays (open bridge) = 954

tax_and_metric.main_metric: after-tax liquidation at the window's last session close: cash + MMF accrued after tax + dividend receivable + (shares*close - sell costs) - 20.315% x max(0, that - basis)
tax_and_metric.also_reported: final market-value total (pre-tax on unrealized gains)
tax_and_metric.tax: 20.315% withheld on each realized gain; MMF and distributions taxed as in the engine; FX fixed at 150 JPY/USD so FX gains are not taxed
tax_and_metric.fees: current Rakuten commission/SEC schedule from the engine, applied to all years

comparison: Per window and delay: rank of each candidate, and whether it beats NO_SELL_I25 after tax. Also share of month-ends inside each window where it beats NO_SELL_I25 after tax. No pooling of money across windows, no average rank.
not_done: No new data download (Yahoo blocked by environment network policy), no adoption, no production change.
